name.en: Building inspections and Certificate of Occupancy

agency.en: City of Dallas Planning & Development (Building Inspection)
agency.zh: 达拉斯市规划与发展局（建筑检查科）

when.en: A new CO is needed for a first use, a change of use, a change of tenant, or a change in floor area. After the application is approved and paid, the space is ready for inspections; when all inspections pass, the CO (or TCO) is released.
when.zh: 首次使用、用途变更、更换租户或面积变化都需要新的入住证（CO）。申请获批并付费后即可安排检查；所有检查通过后签发 CO（或临时 CO）。

book.en: Apply for the CO with the Land Use Questionnaire in DallasNow. Schedule inspections in DallasNow or through the IVR at 214-670-5313. Plumbing final and mechanical final must be requested together for the same day.
book.zh: 在 DallasNow 提交入住证申请及土地用途问卷。在 DallasNow 或拨打自动语音系统 214-670-5313 预约检查。管道最终验收和机械最终验收须同日一起预约。

feeNote.en: Dallas fee table: CO validation inspection $113; temporary CO $500; partial CO $104; duplicate CO or DBA record change $30.
feeNote.zh: 达拉斯收费表：CO 核验检查 113 美元；临时 CO 500 美元；部分 CO 104 美元；补发 CO 或仅改商号 30 美元。

failNext.en: The CO is not released until all inspections pass; correct the items and request the inspection again in DallasNow.
failNext.zh: 所有检查通过前不会签发 CO；整改后在 DallasNow 重新预约检查。

item.en: CO application and Land Use Questionnaire submitted in DallasNow and fee paid
item.zh: 已在 DallasNow 提交入住证申请和土地用途问卷并付费

item.en: For a change of use: dimensioned site plan, floor key plan, tenant floor plan with rooms labeled, and a parking analysis
item.zh: 用途变更时：提交标注尺寸的总平面图、楼层索引图、标明房间用途的租户平面图及停车分析

item.en: Restaurants of 750 sq ft or more: floor plan with square footage, occupant load factors, seating and standing areas, every exit and its door and panic hardware
item.zh: 750 平方英尺以上餐厅：平面图须标明面积、人数荷载系数、座位和站立区、所有出口及门和逃生推杆五金

item.en: Food or beverage use: scaled plans of equipment, plumbing fixtures and floor drains, plus floor, wall and ceiling finish schedules and menu
item.zh: 餐饮用途：按比例绘制的设备、卫生洁具和地漏图，以及地面、墙面、天花板饰面表和菜单

item.en: Building permit on record for the tenant space; any trade permits the CO review requires obtained and finaled
item.zh: 租户空间有建筑许可记录；CO 审查要求的各专业许可已取得并完成验收

item.en: Plumbing final and mechanical final passed
item.zh: 管道最终验收和机械最终验收已通过

item.en: Alcohol Measurement Certification application, if you sell alcohol
item.zh: 如售酒，已提交酒类距离测量认证申请

name.en: Fire acceptance tests (kitchen hood suppression, fire alarm, sprinklers)
name.zh: 消防验收测试（厨房排烟罩灭火、火灾报警、喷淋）

agency.en: Dallas Fire-Rescue, Inspection & Life Safety Education Division (new construction)
agency.zh: 达拉斯消防救援局检查与生命安全教育处（新建工程）

when.en: During the building permit, after the systems are installed and pre-tested, before the CO.
when.zh: 建筑许可期间，系统安装并完成预测试后、取得入住证之前。

book.en: Fire and fire sprinkler inspections are part of permit inspections scheduled in DallasNow. DFR requires documented pre-testing: give the completed Pre-Test Certification form to the inspector or the acceptance test will not start.
book.zh: 消防及喷淋检查属于在 DallasNow 预约的许可检查。DFR 要求提供预测试记录：须将填好的预测试认证表交给检查员，否则不进行验收测试。

lead.en: To cancel or reschedule, notify the assigned inspector by 4:00 p.m. the day before.
lead.zh: 如需取消或改期，须在前一天下午 4 点前通知指派的检查员。

failNext.en: A failed test must be rescheduled; DFR's pre-test letter (2009) says a failed test may carry a $500 retest fee.
failNext.zh: 测试不合格须重新预约；DFR 的预测试通知（2009 年）称不合格可能收取 500 美元重测费。

item.en: Completed Pre-Test Certification form and accurate approved plans on site
item.zh: 现场备有填好的预测试认证表和准确的批准图纸

item.en: Hood suppression actuation automatically shuts off fuel or electric power to the cooking equipment
item.zh: 排烟罩灭火系统启动后自动切断烹饪设备的燃料或电源

item.en: Operation and placement of all hood initiation devices pre-tested; puff test done
item.zh: 排烟罩所有启动装置的功能和位置已预测试；已做吹气测试

item.en: Manual pull in the path of egress, 10 to 20 feet from the cooking equipment, 4.5 to 5 feet above the floor
item.zh: 手动拉启装置位于疏散路线上，距烹饪设备 10 至 20 英尺，离地 4.5 至 5 英尺

item.en: One Class K extinguisher within 30 feet of the hood
item.zh: 排烟罩 30 英尺内配一个 K 类灭火器

item.en: Fire alarm pre-tested: initiating, notification and tamper devices, water-flow timing, audibility, strobe coverage and supervision
item.zh: 火灾报警已预测试：触发、通知和防拆装置，水流报警时间，声响、闪灯覆盖及监控

item.en: Sprinkler piping pressure-tested at 200 psi, hanger spacing and head coverage verified; piping left uncovered until green-tagged
item.zh: 喷淋管道已做 200 psi 压力测试，吊架间距和喷头覆盖已核实；在贴绿签前管道保持外露

item.en: One 2A:10B:C extinguisher per 3,000 sq ft, no more than 75 feet travel apart, mounted 4 inches to 5 feet off the floor
item.zh: 每 3,000 平方英尺配一个 2A:10B:C 灭火器，间隔步行距离不超过 75 英尺，安装高度离地 4 英寸至 5 英尺

name.zh: 消费者健康处开业前检查

agency.en: City of Dallas Consumer Health Division (Code Compliance)
agency.zh: 达拉斯市消费者健康处（规范执法局）

when.en: After you apply for the Food Establishment Permit and plans are approved, before you operate. All defects must be corrected before the health permit is approved.
when.zh: 提交食品场所许可申请且图纸获批后、营业前。所有缺陷须整改完毕才会批准卫生许可。

book.en: After applying, schedule and coordinate all required health inspections with your permitting inspector. For new construction, change of ownership, remodels or a change of use, contact Planning & Development at 214-670-4127.
book.zh: 提交申请后，与负责你许可的检查员预约并协调所有卫生检查。新建、所有权变更、改造或用途变更请联系规划与发展局 214-670-4127。

feeNote.en: Permit application $121; annual permit by risk and size: $141–$155 (risk 1), $283–$308 (risk 2), $468–$513 (risk 3). An optional pre-inspection site evaluation is available for a fee.
feeNote.zh: 许可申请费 121 美元；年度许可按风险和面积：风险 1 级 141–155 美元，2 级 283–308 美元，3 级 468–513 美元。另有收费的开业前现场评估可选。

failNext.en: The inspector notes every item to correct; the permit is approved only after all defects are fixed.
failNext.zh: 检查员会列出所有需整改项；全部整改后才批准许可。

item.en: A valid certified food service manager in place at permit approval
item.zh: 批准许可时须有有效的认证食品服务经理

why.zh: 达拉斯市法规第 17 章

item.en: All exterior doors and service windows self-closing and tight fitting; openings insect- and rodent-proof
item.zh: 所有外门和服务窗自闭且严密；开口防虫防鼠

item.en: Floors sealed concrete, terrazzo or tile sloped to drains; walls FRP, sealed concrete or tile, light colored; no dark ceilings in prep
item.zh: 地面为密封混凝土、水磨石或瓷砖并坡向地漏；墙面为 FRP、密封混凝土或瓷砖且浅色；加工区天花板不得为深色

item.en: Hand sinks within 25 unobstructed feet of each food and dishwashing area (a door counts as an obstruction); hot and cold water through a mixing valve
item.zh: 每个食品区和洗碗区 25 英尺无阻挡范围内有洗手池（门算阻挡）；冷热水经混水阀供应

item.en: Stainless three-compartment sink with drain boards, large enough to submerge the largest equipment (or an NSF dish machine)
item.zh: 不锈钢三格水槽带沥水板，能完全浸没最大的设备（或 NSF 认证洗碗机）

item.en: Utility/mop sink at least 16" x 16" x 14" deep, or a curbed cleaning facility
item.zh: 拖把池至少 16×16 英寸、深 14 英寸，或设围堰清洗区

item.en: Ice machine and food equipment drained through a 1-inch air gap; hoses fitted with backflow devices
item.zh: 制冰机和食品设备排水留 1 英寸空气隔断；软管装防回流装置

item.en: All equipment NSF approved; no home-style equipment; mounted on 6-inch legs, casters or sealed to the floor
item.zh: 所有设备经 NSF 认证；不得使用家用设备；设备装 6 英寸支脚、脚轮或与地面密封

item.en: A working, numerically scaled thermometer in every cold and hot holding unit
item.zh: 每台冷藏和保温设备都有正常工作的数字刻度温度计

item.en: Lights shielded over food and utensils; 50 foot-candles where staff work with food
item.zh: 食品和器具上方灯具有防护罩；员工处理食品处照度达 50 尺烛光

item.en: No utility lines on the floor or exposed in food service areas
item.zh: 食品服务区内地面无管线、无外露管线

item.en: Water heater sized for 120°F+ at dish and hand sinks and kept out of food prep areas (or enclosed)
item.zh: 热水器能为洗碗和洗手池提供 120°F 以上热水，且不设在加工区内（或加封闭隔间）

item.en: Restrooms with self-closing doors, mechanical ventilation, light-colored washable surfaces (FRP to 4 feet) and 100°F+ tempered water
item.zh: 洗手间装自闭门和机械通风，表面浅色可清洗（FRP 至 4 英尺高），提供 100°F 以上温水

name.en: Dallas Fire-Rescue fire inspection (public assembly occupancy)
name.zh: 达拉斯消防救援局消防检查（公共集会场所）

agency.en: Dallas Fire-Rescue, Inspection & Life Safety Education Division
agency.zh: 达拉斯消防救援局检查与生命安全教育处

when.en: After opening. Restaurants and other public assembly occupancies are inspected against the Dallas Fire Code; a valid CO is required.
when.zh: 开业后。餐厅等公共集会场所按达拉斯消防规范接受检查；须持有有效入住证。

book.en: Contact the DFR Inspection & Life Safety Education Division main office.
book.zh: 联系 DFR 检查与生命安全教育处总办公室。

feeNote.en: The initial inspection is free. Reinspections: $171 for the first, $200 for the second, $255 for each after.
feeNote.zh: 首次检查免费。复检：第一次 171 美元，第二次 200 美元，之后每次 255 美元。

failNext.en: You get a list of corrections and a reinspection, billed at $171, then $200, then $255 each.
failNext.zh: 会收到整改清单并安排复检，依次收费 171 美元、200 美元，之后每次 255 美元。

item.en: Valid Certificate of Occupancy
item.zh: 有效的入住证

item.en: Exit doors unlocked and unblocked; panic hardware and outward swing where the occupant load is 50+; illuminated exit signs
item.zh: 出口门不上锁、无阻挡；人数 50 以上时装逃生推杆并向外开；出口指示灯常亮

item.en: Occupant load posted near the main exit and staff keep count
item.zh: 主出口附近张贴人数荷载，员工随时清点人数

item.en: Hood suppression serviced at least every 6 months and after activation; stove and hoods free of grease
item.zh: 排烟罩灭火系统至少每 6 个月及每次启动后维护；炉灶和排烟罩无油污

item.en: Extinguishers inspected annually by licensed individuals and recharged after use; Class K within 30 feet of the hood
item.zh: 灭火器每年由持证人员检查，使用后重新充装；排烟罩 30 英尺内有 K 类灭火器

item.en: Fire alarm and sprinklers tested at least annually with records kept; call DFR at 214-670-4319 if either goes out of service
item.zh: 火灾报警和喷淋至少每年测试并留存记录；任一系统停用时须致电 DFR 214-670-4319

item.en: Storage at least 18 inches below sprinkler deflectors (2 feet below the ceiling if unsprinklered)
item.zh: 储物距喷淋头溅水盘至少 18 英寸（无喷淋时距天花板 2 英尺）

item.en: No extension cords as permanent wiring; power strips plugged directly into wall outlets; cover plates on all panels and boxes
item.zh: 不得用延长线代替永久布线；排插直接插墙上插座；所有配电箱和接线盒有盖板

item.en: CO2 beverage cylinders secured upright and permitted
item.zh: 饮料用二氧化碳钢瓶直立固定并已办理许可

item.en: Open flames and candles permitted by the Fire Marshal; decorations flame-retardant
item.zh: 明火和蜡烛经消防局长许可；装饰物阻燃

item.en: Address numbers at least 6 inches tall, contrasting with the background
item.zh: 门牌号至少 6 英寸高，与背景形成对比

name.zh: 常规食品场所检查（计分）

agency.en: City of Dallas Consumer Health Division
agency.zh: 达拉斯市消费者健康处

when.en: Unannounced, on a risk-based schedule: high risk (restaurants, fast food) twice a year, medium risk (e.g. coffee shops with limited menus) once a year, low risk every other year.
when.zh: 不预先通知，按风险分级安排：高风险（餐厅、快餐）每年两次，中风险（如菜单简单的咖啡店）每年一次，低风险每两年一次。

book.zh: 无需预约，检查员不预先通知上门。

scoring.en: Scored out of 100 based on critical and non-critical violations. 100–80 meets standards; 79–70 needs a follow-up within 30 days; 69–60 within 10 days; 59 and below within 24 hours. Scores are published on the City's Open Data Portal, and you must give a copy of your latest report to any customer who asks.
scoring.zh: 满分 100，按严重和非严重违规扣分。100–80 分达标；79–70 分须在 30 天内复查；69–60 分 10 天内复查；59 分及以下 24 小时内复查。分数公布在市政府开放数据平台；顾客索要时须提供最近一次检查报告复印件。

failNext.en: A score below 80 brings a $191 re-inspection fee. The scores page says 59 or below means closure until a re-inspection.
failNext.zh: 得分低于 80 分须付 191 美元复检费。评分页面称 59 分及以下将停业，直至复检通过。

item.en: Certified food service manager on staff
item.zh: 有认证食品服务经理在职

why.zh: 达拉斯市法规第 17 章

item.en: Working thermometers in every cold and hot holding unit; units holding required temperatures
item.zh: 每台冷藏和保温设备温度计正常，设备保持规定温度

item.en: Food and paper goods stored at least 6 inches off the floor
item.zh: 食品和纸制品离地至少 6 英寸存放

item.en: Pesticides, cleaners and other poisonous substances in separate, labeled cabinets
item.zh: 杀虫剂、清洁剂等有毒物品存放在单独并有标识的柜子里

item.en: Hand sinks accessible, unobstructed and supplied with hot and cold water
item.zh: 洗手池可随时使用、无阻挡，冷热水供应正常

item.en: Exterior doors self-closing and tight fitting; no gaps
item.zh: 外门自闭且严密，无缝隙

item.en: Garbage containers covered; dumpster drain plugs in place
item.zh: 垃圾桶加盖；垃圾箱排水塞到位

item.en: Ice machine drain air gap intact; spray hoses with backflow devices
item.zh: 制冰机排水空气隔断完好；喷水软管装防回流装置

item.en: Latest inspection report on hand for customers who ask
item.zh: 备有最近一次检查报告，供顾客索阅

why.zh: 达拉斯市法规第 17-10.2(b) 条
